summary: Emma Pringle, born about 1865, a Pringle relative whose exact connection to the family is unknown.
bio: Emma Pringle was born about 1865. In 1880 she was a fifteen-year-old servant in the household next to Andrew Pringle's in Plymouth Township. She is probably a relative of the Pringle family, but her exact connection is not known.
sources: 1880 US census, Plymouth Twp (E. Dist., 3d Div.), Luzerne Co., ED 145, p.4, enumerated 4 Jun 1880: https://ancestors.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/sources/LHHH-W68/images/i/0/image.jpg ; record https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MWNZ-S9X
